items.title: Herbie Hancock interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 18, 1995
items.q: I was selected by Mike Green, who is the President of NARAS and, I think he was president at that time... I was asked to do that.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. We have with us today one of the American icons in jazz — Herbie Hancock.
Great, great. I want to just kind of let, say a few little questions and just kind of let you roll on. You were a prodigy.
